findings.title: No row is ever marked current, so Revert is offered on the live version too
findings.owner: CONSUMER (demo/palettes/browser/dialog/VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:26,30,38,76 · demo/palettes/types.ts:66-77)
findings.frame: open-versions__1440__light.png, row-hover__1440__dark.png, open-versions__390__light.png (manifest: currentMarked=0, revertButtons=4 of 4 rows on every frame)
findings.observed: The drawer compares `version.hash === currentHash`. Since X-W3 the list `hash` is the RELEASE id (_id, api routes/versions.ts:12,52), while `Palette.currentHash` is the PAYLOAD hash (service/versions.ts:231; model.ts:140 says payloadHash 'Mirrors Palette.currentHash'). The two can never be equal. As a result no row shows the ring, the inset bar or '(current)', and the newest (live) v4 carries a Revert button. Reverting to it writes a duplicate revision (versionCount+1). The client PaletteVersion type has no `payloadHash` field at all.
findings.expected: The live version is marked and cannot be reverted to. The drawer should compare like with like, as the X-W3 identity split requires (routes/versions.ts:11-13).
findings.fix: Add `payloadHash` to the client PaletteVersion type and compare `version.payloadHash === currentHash`, or have the palette envelope carry the current release id. Hide Revert on the matched row. Add a unit test pinning the identity pair.

findings.title: Revert is invisible on touch but still hit-testable, so a blind tap reverts
findings.owner: CONSUMER (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:79)
findings.frame: row-hover__390__dark.png, open-versions__390__light.png (btn opacity 0, 84x44 hit box at the row's lower-left)
findings.observed: The button is `opacity-0 … group-hover:opacity-100`. On a touch viewport a tap never produces hover, so tapping the row shows nothing (row-hover__390). The 84x44 button stays fully clickable while invisible, so restore cannot be discovered, and a tap on the empty lower-left of a row fires an unconfirmed revert.
findings.expected: Destructive row actions stay visible on touch (or sit in a row menu). An invisible element never receives input.
findings.fix: Show Revert at rest (quiet emphasis), or reveal it with `@media (hover:hover)` only and use `pointer-events-none` while hidden. Better: a per-row action slot that is always present.

findings.title: After a restore the list is stale: still '4 versions', no new revision, nothing marked current
findings.owner: CONSUMER (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:157-167 · demo/palettes/BrowsePane.vue:315-328)
findings.observed: The server appends a revision and sets a new currentHash (service/versions.ts:200-234). The drawer loads only on the `open` transition, so after 'Revert' it still reads 'Harbour Dusk — 4 versions' with the same four rows. The reverted-to row still offers Revert and the new v5 never appears. The only feedback, 'Reverted', paints on the card behind the modal scrim, blurred, and at 390 it is mostly hidden behind the drawer.
findings.expected: A restore visibly lands in the surface that caused it: the list refetches or prepends the returned revision, the current mark moves, and success or failure is announced inside the drawer.
findings.fix: Have onRevert return the verdict to the drawer (emit a promise or pass a result). On ok, call loadVersions(0) and flash the new top row. Render the verdict with the glass feedback primitive in the drawer header or footer instead of the occluded card.

findings.title: No empty state, and a fetch failure looks exactly like an empty history
findings.owner: CONSUMER (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:15-98 · demo/palettes/useVersionHistory.ts:48-54)
findings.observed: With zero versions the drawer is a blank 900px column under 'Quiet Moss — 0 versions'. There is no empty message and no illustration. fetchVersions swallows every error to `undefined` with a console.warn, so a network or 403 failure renders the same blank '0 versions'. findings.observed: onSubmit calls emit('submit') synchronously. `submitting` goes true and back to false in the same tick, and `finally` clears reason and detail at once. The parent then awaits pm.flagged.report() with the dialog still open. For the whole request (2.5 s in 3a; longer through the 429 retry backoff in 3d) the dialog shows an empty form: no radio checked (metrics: all aria-checked=false), textarea value '', Report disabled, no spinner. verdicts.title: Radio rows: hand-rolled labels, 44px hit boxes overlap on a 31px pitch
verdicts.why: The overlap is confirmed (radios 44x44 at y=339/370/401/432, pitch 31). The mechanism is more specific than the audit says. The consumer's `class="flex flex-col gap-2"` on RadioGroup (:16) overrides that gap to 8px, and the per-item <div> wrapper takes the rows off the group's flex axis. The consumer override causes the overlap, so the CONSUMER owner is right. Glass HEAD makes the 44px seat in-flow at gap 0 ('GAP 0 IS THE PITCH', radio-group/styles.css). findings.title: Colors mode is dead: the add-slot and every 'From palettes' swatch render as inert aria-hidden spans, so no color can ever be added and Mix stays disabled
findings.owner: CONSUMER — demo/workbenches/mix/MixSourceSelector.vue:195-207 (ghost add slot) and :242-252 (palette swatches) pass tag="button", @click, aria-label, :disabled and a <Plus> slot to WatercolorDot. The served glass-ui 7.0.0 WatercolorDot (node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/watercolor-dot.js:79-120) has no `tag` prop, sets inheritAttrs:false, forwards only class and style, and hard-codes <span aria-hidden="true" style="pointer-events:none"> with no default slot. This is version skew: the consumer calls an interactive WatercolorDot API that the pinned producer does not ship.
findings.state: Colors tab: sources empty → attempt to choose sources

Selected chips stay at 0 before and after a forced click on the ghost and a click on the swatches. The Mix button stays disabled. The pane's accessibility tree holds only 6 buttons (2 tabs, the collapsible trigger, 2 comboboxes, Mix): none of the ~15 'Add color … from …' buttons exist. Every Colors-mode path downstream is unreachable: the chosen state, the chip-remove affordance, the Space/Hue PreviewRamps (which need 2 or more operands), the Colors-mode convergence animation, and the dock Tools→Mix/Copy verbs.
findings.expected: Each add affordance is a real <button> with an accessible name and a working click, and the ghost shows its Plus glyph. Pages must work when used.
findings.fix: Either repin to the glass release whose WatercolorDot takes `tag` and forwards attrs and slots, or (consumer-local, today) wrap each dot in a native <button type=button aria-label … @click> and keep the dot purely decorative. Add an e2e test that clicks add and checks the chip count, so a producer skew cannot silently kill the verb again.

verdicts.title: Swatch copy verb is dead (WatercolorDot drops tag/@click/aria-label)
verdicts.why: The installed glass 7.0.0 dist/watercolor-dot.js has inheritAttrs:!1 and no tag prop. It forwards only class and style onto a <span aria-hidden=true style=pointer-events:none>. GenerateControls.vue:206-215 passes :aria-label and @click, and both are dropped. probe-log swatchCopy.clip='SENTINEL'. The owner is CONSUMER, and the scope needs amending in three ways. (a) glass HEAD src/components has no watercolor-dot at all: blob/README.md:7 says it relocated to value.js at BK #55. value.js still imports @mkbabb/glass-ui/watercolor-dot and has no local copy, so the seat must be built in value.js. (b) The same dead tag="button" pattern breaks SwatchHoverMenu.vue:14-32 (the palette-card swatch popover and hover trigger) and MixSourceSelector.vue:242-251 (add color from a palette). So the 'palette-card swatch popover' that the fix cites as its idiom is probably dead too. (c) The tag="div" consumers are EmptyState.vue:35-37, CurrentPaletteEditor.vue:62-64 and MixSourceSelector.vue:179.

verdicts.title: At 390, control type (21px) out-ranks the headings
verdicts.why: The symptom is confirmed in 390-light-01-default.png, where 'Vibrant'/'Golden' and 'Regenerate' dwarf the 'Preset' labels. I traced the cause, and the owner is GLASS, not the consumer. glass tokens/light-dark.css (dist 7.0.0 and HEAD src/styles/tokens/light-dark.css:17-21) sets --ui-scale: var(--ui-coarse-scale, 1.5) under @media (pointer: coarse). sizing.css:35-36 then defines --control-text: calc(var(--type-small) * var(--ui-scale)) and --control-text-sm likewise, so a 14px base becomes 21px on touch. The heading and title ladder is not scaled, so the controls invert the hierarchy. This contradicts DESIGN.md:931-937, which says coarse input should lift the target through --control-floor. Route to glass: decouple --control-text from --ui-scale, or scale the whole ladder. As an interim, the consumer can set --ui-coarse-scale. 390 in this capture is hasTouch, so this is really a coarse-pointer effect, not a width effect.

verdicts.title: Count slider track is a hand-rolled absolute gradient div under a transparent Slider track

The glass HEAD src has no --slider-track-bg reference at all, so the cure must target the seam that HEAD's Slider actually exposes at upgrade time, not the 7.0.0 name.

verdicts.title: The plate name is a hand-rolled bare <input>
verdicts.why: GenerateControls.vue:151-156 has 'hover:underline decoration-dashed ... focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/40' and no .focus-ring, while every Button on the plate carries focus-ring (probe-log focusTour class strings). The affordance is hover-only, so it is invisible on touch.

verdicts.title: Select popups are item-aligned and cover their own label and the plate
verdicts.why: The mechanism is wrong. Glass forces popper: HEAD src/components/select/SelectContent.vue:48-56 spreads position:'popper', avoidCollisions:true and collisionPadding:16 LAST, and the 7.0.0 dist select-*.js:176-179 strips any consumer position. The consumer therefore CANNOT pass position='popper', because it already is popper. The frames show a collision FLIP to side=top: the full-height list (6 or 10 rows, each two-line) will not fit below the trigger. In 1440-dark-08-harmony-open.png it opens above and covers the 'Harmony' label and half the plate. In 390-light-07-preset-open.png it rises over the header and plate and shows 5 of 10 items. The owner is GLASS: cap the content at the available height (e.g. --reka-select-content-available-height) so it stays on the preferred bottom side and scrolls, rather than flipping over the field's own label. The consumer-side 'fix' in the original finding is void.

audit.page: value.js /#/gradient (Gradient stage + My Palettes inspector). The gradient view has 2 BROKEN defects: at 390px the three Select triggers overlap each other and the render tile, and the stop Position input cuts off its own value at both widths. There are also 5 HIGH findings: the easing editor is built into the Gradient card instead of living in a separate pane (the idiom the owner ruled on); the curve editor is letterboxed and its endpoint handles are cut off; Copy CSS copies a 32-stop sampled string, not the CSS shown on screen; the rendered gradient is a small side tile, not the main surface; and Direction still shows for Radial, where it does nothing. Scene actions Reset, Seed and Copy worked, the parse check caught invalid CSS, and no console errors or non-GET requests appeared at any viewport or theme. Environment: the machine was heavily loaded (load average 60-280, :9000 took 32-114 s and stopped answering for about 10 min). My first 1440-light run showed only the atmosphere, and my first 390-light run stuck on 'Loading the scene…' for more than 10 minutes. I reran both and they completed, so those failures are environmental. I did not start, stop or restart any server. COLLATERAL: early on, my `pkill -f "gradient-view/capture.mjs|node capture.mjs"` matched any process named `node capture.mjs`. It may have killed other audit seats' capture runs (about 12:00-12:15), so their frames may be incomplete. After that I renamed my scripts to gv-*.mjs and only killed processes by PID after checking their working directory.

It also has its own specimen gallery (EasingTarget.vue), of which value.js's EasingSpecimenStrip is a hand transposition. So there are two seats, two galleries, and two sets of chrome for one curve editor.
findings.expected: One animation/easing idiom across all views (COHESION §0bl OA-37: 'NO one-off instances'). A curve is chosen in one gallery primitive and authored in one editor seat, with the editor in its own pane/panel beside the thing it drives. It should not be poured into an accordion row with local overrides of the producer's internals.
findings.fix: Glass publishes the gallery and the seat. Options: an EasingGallery (or a gallery mode on the easing family), plus seat behaviour (preset display, bare surface, one column) as props, so neither consumer overrides internals. value.js then opens the editor in a separate surface (a side pane or sheet anchored to the interval, like kf's timing panel) and deletes EasingAuthoringStage's :deep laws. keyframes and value.js consume the same two primitives.

confirm.page: value.js gradient-easing-authoring (/#/gradient → Easing). Confirm seat, working read-only. My probe run: value.js c5368a51 with 4 dirty, glass-ui 6433284a with 0 dirty (HEAD has moved on from ddf6385a), installed @mkbabb/glass-ui 7.0.0, keyframes.js 6d5b4288. I did one headed-Chromium DOM probe at 1440 light (scratchpad probe.mjs; nothing was written to the app trees) and re-read frames 01-el, 05, 06, 09-el and 10 at 1440-light, plus 390-dark-06. Result: 16 findings, 11 confirmed, 5 amended, 0 refuted. The biggest amendment is the root cause of the unpainted chips. At 7.0.0, Chip DOES render data-mode="selectable" (data-state=on, aria-pressed=true, data-shape=icon), and --accent-band resolves on the chip. The real cause is that glass 7.0.0 ships dist/styles/glass/glass-chip.css but no entry imports it: glass.css, index.css and glass-ui.css all lack it (glass-ui.css has 0 '.glass-chip' matches). As a result, zero `.glass-chip[data-mode…]` rules are loaded on the page, and a synthetic `.glass-chip.glass-capsule.glass-chip--cell` computes border-radius 9999px. Glass cured this at 4442b451 ('re-home glass-chip + glass-atom @imports into glass.css closure'), which is in v8.0.0, v9.0.0, v10.0.0 and v10.0.1.

findings.frame: 1440-light-01-default.png (crop: grey fill inset from the capsule edge, not covering the icon), 390-light-01c-fullpage.png, 1440-dark-06a-after-copy.png
findings.observed: A stadium dock holds two stadium 'ghost' buttons, pill in pill in card, above a separator rule. Ghost renders a filled oklab(.72/.6) capsule. In light theme the grey fill is narrower than its capsule, a visibly misregistered lozenge. This is the 'too rounded pills' pattern the owner named.
findings.expected: GlassDock is the dock container (--radius-dock, DESIGN.md:396). A card footer's secondary actions are plain Buttons in the card or Configurator footer. Ghost has no resting fill. Card-like surfaces rather than nested stadiums (owner 2026-09-23).
findings.fix: Consumer: replace the GlassDock with a plain right-aligned footer row of Button ghost/sm, or use the Configurator's commit/reset slot. Glass: fix the ghost resting fill, and the glass-wash layer's inset so it does not misregister, inside dock contexts.

findings.title: Copy JSON gives no feedback; Reset has no 'modified' state

findings.title: Console well radius 12 px inside a 16 px card at a 24 px inset breaks the concentric rule
findings.owner: CONSUMER — ConfigSliderPane.vue:122 (.console-well) inside the rounded-card Card
findings.observed: Card 16 px (--radius-card), well 12 px at a 24 px inset. The nested corner reads rounder than its container allows.

findings.title: Lazy pane load has no timeout, so a stalled chunk leaves 'Loading the scene…' forever
findings.owner: CONSUMER — demo/shell/usePaneRouter.ts:269-282 (defineAsyncComponent with errorComponent but no `timeout`)
findings.observed: Under host load (load average ~100) the plate stayed more than 150 s with no error or retry, and PaneErrorPlate never showed. The plate also sits vertically centred while the loaded pane anchors at the top, so the layout jumps on resolve. PLAUSIBLE: the trigger was environmental, the missing timeout is structural.
findings.expected: Loading → error/retry within a bounded time; the loading plate occupies the loaded pane's slot.
findings.fix: Pass a `timeout` (e.g. 20 s) so PaneErrorPlate and retry appear, and top-anchor the loading plate to the pane's resting position.

confirm.page: value.js /#/atmosphere (atmosphere-view). Fresh confirm seat, read-only. Trees at confirm time: value.js c5368a51 (dirty 4); glass-ui 6433284a (dirty 3), which differs from the ddf6385a the audit cites. The consumer still resolves node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui 7.0.0 dist. Method: I re-read the frames (1440-light-01-default, 1440-light-04-medium-oil-pastel, 1440-dark-03a2-harmony-kbd-hover, 390-light-01c-fullpage, 390-light-03a-select-harmony-open, probe-1x-texture-vangogh), ran pixel statistics with PIL on the hover pair, the smooth frame and the texture probes, re-read probe-ground.json and probe-type.json, and checked the source: AuroraPane.vue, ConfigSliderPane.vue, DockViewSelect.vue:87, usePaneRouter.ts:269-282, glass 7.0.0 dist (semantic.css, button chunk, select chunk), and glass HEAD (SelectTrigger.vue:59, SelectItem.vue, light-dark.css:17-22, semantic.css:224, DESIGN.md:380-400 and 1436-1465, Configurator.vue:26-49). Result: I could not refute any of the 20 findings in substance. Ten of them are AMENDED for wrong line numbers, a wrong citation or a wrong mechanism: the footer button 'ghost' claim, the Configurator stage-dominant citation, and the AuroraPane line offsets.

verdicts.title: Medium 'Oil Pastel' turns the whole atmosphere ground black
verdicts.why: 1440-light-04-medium-oil-pastel.png shows a near-black ground with faint grain and the card gone grey-muddy. probe-ground.json shows 188.7→22.5 at 4320 ms, holding for 11 s. In 1440-light-04-medium-smooth.png the corner mean luminance is 23.3, so it is still black after the switch back. GLASS owner call stands: the consumer only sets {kind}. Line cite amended: MEDIA is AuroraPane.vue:60-68 and setMedium is :91-97, not :57-65 and :92-98.

verdicts.title: Textured media (pastel, watercolor, oil, crayon, Van Gogh) look identical to Smooth
verdicts.why: probe-1x-texture-vangogh.png is a plain soft gradient. Crop luminance std: smooth 4.76, watercolor 3.79, crayon 5.76, vangogh 6.71, oil-pastel 4.21. verdicts.title: Atom changes land about 4 s after the pick, with a hard cut

verdicts.title: Sliders render as heavy solid slabs with no filled range and a hard-to-read readout
verdicts.why: ConfigSliderPane.vue:146 sets variant="spectrum" and :202 sets --slider-track-bg: var(--ink-muted). The comment at :194 itself admits 'the spectrum .slider-range is transparent by recipe'. fmt at :84-86 gives toFixed(3) or an integer. The frames show dark slabs in light theme and light-grey slabs in dark theme (1440-dark-03a2). At 390, the Zones thumb also overhangs the track end.

verdicts.title: Action footer: two capsule buttons inside a GlassDock pill inside the card, with a misregistered fill
verdicts.why: Pill-in-pill-in-card is confirmed (ConfigSliderPane.vue:163-174). The inset grey lozenge is clearly visible in 390-light-01c and 1440-light-01-default. It is absent in dark (1440-dark-03a2 renders clean outlined capsules), so the misregistration is light-theme only. The mechanism is wrong: the consumer passes no variant (`<Button size="sm">`). Glass 7.0.0 Button defaults to emphasis 'secondary', and neutral tone plus primary/secondary emphasis adds 'glass-wash glass-capsule'. This is not 'ghost', so 'ghost has no resting fill' is not the governing expectation. Consumer fix: pass a lower emphasis and drop the GlassDock. Glass fix: the glass-wash inset misregistration in light theme.

Captured with HEADED Chromium on the real GPU at 1440x900 and 390x844, light and dark (dpr 2), against dev server :9000. findings.title: Blob pane Geometry sliders do nothing: the only blob on the page ignores them
findings.owner: CONSUMER — demo/picker/visual/HeroBlob.vue:152-165 (heroConfig hard-codes geometry.bodyRadius 0.325, orbitRadius 0.4, satelliteRadius 0.09, eccentricity 0.03 over appBlobConfig) + demo/scenes/blob/BlobPane.vue:57-63 (the sliders that drive those keys)
findings.frame: crops/probe-blob-strip.png (probe-B-sat0 vs probe-B-sat4, probe-C-body-min vs probe-C-body-max); crops/1440-light-blob-strip.png (01-default vs 06-tuned-live, bodyRadius 0.22→0.45, satellites 3→4, smoothK 0.05→0.45)
findings.observed: I moved Body Radius from min to max and Satellites from 0 to 4. The hero blob rendered pixel-identical in both cases. The page has 2 canvases (the app-layout aurora and the one goo-blob-wrapper), so the tuning surface has no other blob it could be driving. 4 of the 5 Geometry sliders are overwritten by the hero overlay on every frame, and Satellites has no visible effect.
findings.expected: Every slider in a tuning pane produces a visible response on the thing being tuned. BlobPane.vue:43-46 states the pane's own law: an abrogated key must 'fail typecheck rather than silently no-op a slider'. A pinned overlay is exactly that silencer.
findings.fix: Give the blob scene its own blob, rendered from the un-overlaid app config (see the next finding). Or have the hero derive its register by scaling appBlobConfig.geometry instead of pinning literals. Or remove the sliders the hero pins. Never keep a live slider that is a no-op.

findings.title: The blob scene's subject is a 113px ornament in the corner and scrolls away while you tune it
findings.owner: CONSUMER — demo/shell/viewSchema.ts:218-225 (blob scene: stage = color-picker, inspector = blob) + demo/picker/visual/HeroBlob.vue:2-10 (aria-hidden, pointer-events-none ornament)
findings.observed: The stage is the whole colour picker (spectrum and channel console), which has nothing to do with blob tuning. The blob is a 113x113 decorative bead at the card's top-right (metrics: hero-blob-anchor box [598,-1,113,113]). Scrolling to Lit Glass, Pointer, Satellites or Tempo leaves the left half of the viewport as empty gradient (03/10), so the blob is not visible while you tune those sliders. At 390 the first slider sits below the entire picker, so the blob and the sliders are never on screen together. The Pointer sliders (Attraction, Strength, Stretch, Click Impulse) cannot be tried at all, because the hero is pointer-events-none.
findings.expected: The tuned subject is the dominant, always-visible content of its own scene. The sibling Atmosphere scene (viewSchema.ts:212-216) gives its subject the stage and nothing beside it. Scenes should share one grammar: the subject on the stage, the controls in the inspector.
findings.fix: Blob scene: stage = a dedicated interactive blob stage (a large Blob that pointer events can reach, sticky or viewport-bounded), inspector = BlobPane. Drop the picker from this scene. At <lg, pin the stage above the pane or use a sheet.

findings.title: Inspector card has no height bound (2693px), so the 'docked' Copy/Reset footer sits 1700px below the fold
findings.owner: CONSUMER — demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:109-189 (Card h-full + flex-1 scroll region + flex-none footer, which only works under a bounded parent) and the blob scene's inspector region sizing
findings.state: default config sliders; Copy JSON / Reset
findings.frame: 1440-light-01-default.png, 1440-light-03-pane-scrolled-bottom.png; 1440-light-metrics.json (card box h=2693, scroll sh=2614 == ch=2614, actionBar y=2614)
findings.observed: The scroll host never scrolls: scrollHeight equals clientHeight at 2614, so the whole page scrolls instead. The action bar that ConfigSliderPane.vue:171-174 says is 'docked below the scroll region so it can never occlude a slider' is at y=2614 at 1440 and y≈7800 at 390. It can only be reached after scrolling past all 31 sliders. The picker card beside it is bounded at about 950px, so the two cards of one scene are wildly different heights.
findings.expected: Inspector panes are bounded to the viewport. The pane-scroll-fade region scrolls internally, and the footer actions are always visible, which is what the component's own comment says.
findings.fix: Bound the inspector region's block size (e.g. min(100dvh - dock offset, content)) so Card h-full resolves. Or make .config-action-bar sticky at the bottom of the card.

findings.title: Configurator chrome is hand-rolled around ConfiguratorRow instead of using the glass-ui configurator family
findings.owner: CONSUMER — demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:143-146 + :221-233 (config-section-header/-title reproduce ConfiguratorLayer's section label), :93-95 (resetDefaults = Object.assign, re-rolling useConfiguratorState.reset), :176-187 (GlassDock + ghost Buttons as the action bar); ConfiguratorRow canReset never used
findings.observed: Seven hand-rolled mono, caps, letterspaced section headers with a hairline (16.4px, the same size as the row labels). A bespoke reset that restores everything at once. No per-row reset, no presets, no collapse. The file's header comment says 'the section-group wrapper and the floating copy/reset dock remain demo-local'.
findings.expected: glass-ui DESIGN.md:1438-1443: the configurator family (Configurator / ConfiguratorLayer / ConfiguratorRow / useConfiguratorState) is 'the canonical chrome for live token/preset editing'. ConfiguratorLayer carries the section label (--configurator-section-{size,weight}) and the section radius. ConfiguratorRow.vue:79-93 provides canReset per row.
findings.fix: Compose ConfiguratorLayer per section and useConfiguratorState<BlobConfig> for reset, commit and presets. Enable ConfiguratorRow canReset per row. Delete .config-section-header/.config-section-title. If ConfiguratorLayer lacks a needed axis, route that gap to the glass-ui session rather than forking it.

findings.title: 31-slider wall with no disclosure, jargon labels, and duplicate row names
findings.owner: CONSUMER — demo/scenes/blob/BlobPane.vue:54-116 (SECTIONS)
findings.observed: 31 rows across 7 sections, all expanded at once. 'Noise Freq' and 'Noise Speed' each appear twice (Membrane and Color) with no qualifier. The labels are internal jargon ('Smooth K', 'Sat Radius', 'Rim Power', 'Sub-surface'). Tempo is a whole section with a single slider. Nothing ranks importance.
findings.expected: Clutter rule: controls earn their place. The canon family provides ConfiguratorLayer for grouped, collapsible sections. Each label is unique and meaningful within the pane.
findings.fix: Use collapsible layers with Geometry and Membrane open by default and the rest collapsed. Qualify duplicated labels ('Membrane noise freq' / 'Colour noise freq') or rely on unique layer context plus sub. Fold Tempo into Membrane or Pointer. Consider hiding the expert atoms (Rim Power, Shininess) behind an 'Advanced' layer.

findings.title: Config slider tracks are heavy flat slabs with no filled range
findings.owner: CONSUMER — demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:152-160 (variant="spectrum") + :196-213 (--slider-track-bg: var(--ink-muted) override)
findings.observed: Each row is a 24px, fully inked stadium with a transparent range (the spectrum recipe has no fill), so position reads only from a thin thumb. 31 identical charcoal (light) or #a8a8a8-ish (dark) bars dominate the pane visually over the labels and values. Beside them, the picker's channel sliders carry meaning in their gradients. Focus shows only as a faint ring on the thumb (05 vs 04 are nearly identical).
findings.expected: A value slider shows its filled extent, as the glass Slider default variant does, with the range tinted by accent. The spectrum variant is for tracks that carry a gradient, which is the picker's use. Focus is clearly visible.

verdicts.title: Blob pane Geometry sliders do nothing: the only blob on the page ignores them
verdicts.verdict: AMENDED (confirmed, and it is wider than reported)
verdicts.why: The four probe frames (sat0, sat4, body-min, body-max) are identical, and HeroBlob.vue:163-169 pins bodyRadius, orbitRadius, satelliteRadius and eccentricity (and fissionAmp at :174). But 06-tuned-live also changed smoothK from 0.05 to 0.45, which is NOT pinned, and the blob still did not change. The root cause is wider than the overlay. HeroBlob's idle gate (:211-225) parks the renderer 5.3s after the last colour or save activity, and slider writes never call noteBlobActivity. Blob.vue only wakes a parked renderer on color, paletteStops, satelliteColors, rimColor or pointer.active (:185-243). So every one of the 31 sliders (membrane, surface, color shifts, tempo, satellites) is silent while the hero is parked, not only the four pinned Geometry keys. verdicts.title: Action bar: ghost buttons nested as pills inside a pill dock, with a grey slab that does not fit the button shape
verdicts.why: The frame reproduces: crops/1440-light-actionbar shows a grey slab inset inside each stadium, with a clipped left edge, and all of it inside the dock stadium. But the buttons were never ghost buttons. Glass 7 Button has no variant prop. It uses emphasis (primary | secondary | quiet | text, default 'secondary': Button.vue:39,63-65), and it lists variant as a retired attribute that 'paints nothing' (:127-143). Commit 69c0d255 has since deleted the inert variant="ghost" at ConfigSliderPane.vue:165/169. The resting fill is therefore the secondary capsule plate, as designed, so the primary owner is CONSUMER: pass emphasis="quiet" or "text", or drop the GlassDock wrapper (a dock is not a pane-footer container per the DESIGN.md:385-391 role table). The remaining GLASS question is narrower: why a secondary glass-capsule's plate renders misregistered (slab offset from the button's own stadium) when nested inside GlassDock's backdrop. That looks like a nested backdrop-filter or specular-track registration issue, and only that part should be routed to the glass-ui session.

findings.title: Retry on 'Couldn't load users' does nothing for up to 30 s
findings.owner: CONSUMER demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminUsersPanel.vue:74-77 + demo/platform/transport/availability.ts:87,251-268

verdicts.title: Pending|Approved segmented-tab indicator lands below its track on every entry to the view
verdicts.why: The symptom is confirmed. In 1440-light-01-empty-pending.png the indicator is about 48 px tall and sits about 21 px low on a 39 px track (the buttons measure 31 px in the manifest), and it covers the search placeholder. In 1440-light-05 it is correct after a tab change. 390-dark-15-loading.png shows a smaller offset of about 8 px. The owner call (GLASS) stands, but the stated mechanism is wrong. useSelectionIndicator.ts:223-231 computes x/y as btnRect minus containerRect, so a pure ancestor translate cancels out. A uniform scale would shrink or grow the width too, yet the indicator's width is exactly right (492 px) while only its height and y are wrong. The error is anisotropic (height and y only), so 'the ancestor transform is live at mount' does not explain it. Likely causes are a first measure taken before the button's layout or font settles, or a y-only entrance transform (scaleY or clip). Glass should re-measure after settle (rAF, document.fonts.ready, or a ResizeObserver on the button). Glass should still own the fix, with the corrected diagnosis.

findings.title: Turning a page removes the pager, drops keyboard focus to BODY, and collapses the card to 3 skeletons
findings.owner: CONSUMER demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminAuditPanel.vue:48-49 + :80/:105 (the loading branch swaps out rows and PaginationBar); demo/palettes/useAdminAudit.ts:54-75

findings.title: Tabular log drawn as 20 separately bordered cards: large vertical cost and dead width
findings.owner: CONSUMER demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminAuditPanel.vue:80-102; GLASS DataTable exists (glass-ui DESIGN.md:1612-1617)
findings.observed: Each audit entry is its own 1px-bordered 6px-radius box, 992x73 css px for two short lines. At 1440 about 70% of each box is empty to the right. 20 rows make the pane 1942px tall in a 900px viewport, so only ~7 entries are visible and the pager needs about 1170px of scrolling. The stacked boxes are the clutter the owner flagged ('cluttered', 'not glass-ui idiomatic').
findings.expected: An audit log is a table (time / action / actor / target). glass-ui ships DataTable with responsive projection and stable row identity (DESIGN.md:1612-1617). The library idiom is hairline-separated rows in one surface, not a card per record.
findings.fix: Replace the v-for boxes with glass-ui DataTable: columns Time (tabular-nums) | Action (sm badge) | Actor | Target (mono, truncate), with row separators and no per-row border. At 390 project to two lines per row inside the same table surface. Keep the caller-owned pagination.

findings.title: Action badge is the loudest text in each row (16.4px semibold uppercase) and every action shares one neutral tone
findings.owner: CONSUMER demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminAuditPanel.vue:89 (class 'text-mono-caption' loses to Badge SIZE md; no size/tone passed)
findings.frame: docs/tranches/X/audit/ui-evidence/value/admin-audit/p2-entries-1440-light.png, p2-rowhover-crop-1440-dark.png, capture2-log-light.json (badge fs 16.4px fw 600 tf uppercase)

The time text is also 16.4px and the pane description is 14.4px, so 'DELETE-USER' / 'IMPERSONATE' shouts in every row. The consumer's text-mono-caption never applies: Badge's size axis (default md = --control-label) wins. Destructive acts (delete-user, delete-palette, impersonate) look the same as approve-color.
findings.expected: glass-ui Badge has a size axis (sm = --type-caption) and a tone axis (neutral/destructive/success/warning/info), glass-ui src/components/badge/index.ts:44-66, 'a tone is not a style'. A caption-scale mark should sit under the primary line, and severity should be carried by tone.
findings.fix: <Badge size="sm" :tone="toneFor(entry.action)"> with delete-* -> destructive, approve-* -> success, reject-* -> warning, impersonate -> warning/info. Drop the class override and the uppercase caps register.

verdicts.title: At 390 the rows push the list wider than the card: count, Refresh and Next page end up off-card

Every rect ends at 33+552=585, so the grid track itself blew out to the row's min-content, as the finding says. The :84 row has no min-w-0, and AdminListItem.vue:6-10 documents exactly this S.W5-12 fix. p2-entries-390-light.png shows the target 'color:very-long-colour-name-that-keeps' cut by the card edge with no ellipsis. The target span measures 526px (log), so truncate never fires. Owner CONSUMER is correct.

verdicts.title: Turning a page removes the pager, drops keyboard focus to BODY, and collapses the card to 3 skeletons
verdicts.why: The mechanism is confirmed in code: useAdminAudit.ts:54 sets loading=true on every nextPage/prevPage, and AdminAuditPanel.vue:48 v-else-if loading replaces the whole template containing the rows and PaginationBar. The log shows active=BODY for entries-p2 and entries-p3-last at both viewports. Amendment: the 1940→359→1940 height sequence was not measured during a page turn. The 359 comes from the separate 6 s initial-load capture (paneScroll [359,359]). The collapse follows from the code, but it is an inference. Addition: the pager's aria-live 'Page n of m' region is unmounted and remounted on each turn. A live region inserted together with its content is usually not announced, so the page change is also silent to screen readers.

verdicts.title: Tabular log drawn as 20 separately bordered cards
verdicts.why: The log shows row0 at 992x73 with a 6px radius and a 1px border-card-edge. p2-entries-1440-dark.png shows the stacked boxes, most of them empty to the right. The claim 'text-mono-caption never applies' holds from the measurement. glass badge/index.ts:59-66 at HEAD has TONE (neutral/destructive/success/warning/info) and SIZE sm=--type-caption, and the consumer passes neither. The frames show DELETE-USER, IMPERSONATE and APPROVE-COLOR in the identical neutral plate.

verdicts.title: Offset pagination skips reports after in-place Dismiss/Delete
verdicts.why: Dismiss half CONFIRMED. api service/flagged.ts dismissFlags deletes the flags, the server list shrinks, removeRow (useAdminFlagged.ts:105-112) only filters locally, and nextPage reads (page-1)*20, so N reports are skipped. The Delete half is WRONG in mechanism and worse. DELETE /admin/palettes/:slug is a soft delete (service/palettes.ts:1-16 says in so many words that it cascades neither votes nor flags), and the aggregate $lookup (repository/flag.ts:96-103) does not filter deletedAt. A deleted palette keeps its flags, stays in countDistinctPalettes and returns on the next read. It returns with its name and swatches intact (the lookup still matches the soft-deleted row), so it looks like a live report. The client total-- is also wrong for delete. Fix: a CONSUMER re-read of the current page after either act, plus an API fix: cascade-dismiss the flags on admin delete, or add a {deletedAt: null} filter to the $lookup pipeline and count.

confirm.page: value.js admin-tags (/#/admin/tags). This confirm seat re-read the frames, the manifests, the source and glass. Tree state at confirm: value.js c5368a51 with 4 dirty files; glass-ui 6433284a with 3 dirty files (glass has moved past the audit's 79c3601b); glass installed in value.js is 7.0.0. Sources read: demo/palettes/browser/admin/AdminTagsPanel.vue, demo/palettes/admin/AdminPane.vue:132-146, demo/palettes/useAdminTags.ts:66-74, glass DESIGN.md:380-395, glass src/components/chip (README, Chip.vue:121-140), src/styles/glass/glass-chip.css:60-130, src/components/button/styles.css:250-255 and Button.vue:171, src/styles/utilities/responsive.css, src/components/skeleton/Skeleton.vue:59-66, src/components/dialog/styles.css:14-25, and the installed dist (button/styles.css, Button.vue.d.ts, glass-ui.css .skeleton[data-v], styles/glass/glass-chip.css, styles/utilities/responsive.css). Frames viewed: 390-light-03, 390-light-08, 1440-dark-05, 1440-light-11. Result: 11 findings; 8 CONFIRMED and 3 AMENDED (#2, #3, #8), none refuted. The largest correction is #3: glass 7.0.0 already makes an icon-only Button 44×44 on touch screens, so no glass change is needed there. Six things the audit missed are listed separately.

verdicts.title: Tag chip is hand-rolled instead of glass Chip mode="removable"; ✕ is off canon (4px radius, 16px touch target, square focus ring)
verdicts.why: AdminTagsPanel.vue:128-148 is exactly the hand-rolled markup described (rounded-full div; button with p-0.5 rounded-sm). The manifest has chip.x at w16 h16 radius 4px in every 1440 and 390 frame. In 1440-dark-05 the focus ring is a square box pressed against 'calm'. Installed glass 7.0.0 has ChipMode 'removable' (dist chip/types.d.ts:4,42). On a touch screen its installed CSS gives the chip a 44px minimum height and the remove button a 44×44 hit area (inline-size and block-size = --touch-target), with a 1.25rem stadium glyph inside. DESIGN.md:387 puts 'tag delete' in the --radius-control stadium role. The owner call (CONSUMER) is correct and the fix works as described.

verdicts.title: Long tag names wrap to two lines inside a stadium chip at 390 (multi-line holder at stadium radius)
verdicts.why: The observation is confirmed: in 390-light-03 the long chip is w324 h49 with radius 1.67e7px (fully rounded) and wraps to two lines, and 390-light-08 shows the same. The owner call needs amending to CONSUMER plus GLASS. The finding's conditional has come true: glass Chip does not truncate at HEAD or at 7.0.0. .glass-chip__content only sets min-inline-size:0 (glass-chip.css:69-71); there is no nowrap or ellipsis anywhere in chip/ or glass-chip.css, and chipVariants base has no whitespace class. Adopting Chip will therefore not stop the wrap. Relay a root fix to glass: the pill/removable Chip content should be white-space:nowrap with text-overflow:ellipsis, plus overflow:hidden and max-inline-size:100% on the chip. Until that lands, the consumer puts the full name in the title attribute.

verdicts.title: At 390 the Refresh and Create icon buttons render as 28×44 vertical capsules
verdicts.why: The observation is confirmed (manifest refresh/create w28 h44 radius 9999px at 390). The fix and the GLASS relay are wrong. ButtonSize at 7.0.0 is xs|sm|md|lg, so there is no size="icon". The Button has an iconOnly prop (dist Button.vue.d.ts:13). It sets data-icon-only, which makes inline-size equal block-size equal --button-size with padding 0, and data-control-target, which applies the touch floor to BOTH axes (installed dist/styles/utilities/responsive.css: min-block-size and min-inline-size = --touch-target). Glass already does what the relay asks for. Owner is CONSUMER only: add `icon-only` to both Buttons and drop `px-2` (AdminTagsPanel.vue:14, :66-69). No glass relay.

verdicts.title: At 390 the primary name field is narrower than the category field and clips its own placeholder
verdicts.why: The manifest has nameInput w136 h54 against catInput w144 at 390. 390-light-03 shows 'Tag name' cut at the final 'e'. The comment at :44-46 claims this was fixed, but the fixed class w-36 on the category field makes it wider than the flex-1 name field at a 324px content width. The CONSUMER owner is correct.

verdicts.title: Count + Refresh toolbar wastes a full row, duplicates the empty message, and breaks the sibling admin idiom (header badge)

verdicts.title: At 390 the delete-confirm Dialog is full-bleed (no side gutter), with rounded corners against the screen edge and a large dead bottom pad
verdicts.why: Confirmed: at 390 the dialog is x0 w390 radius 16, and the installed class 'w-full max-w-lg' has no gutter. 390-light-08 shows the full-bleed plate and about 90px of dead pad under Cancel. findings.title: Home CTA passes a retired glass-ui prop: variant="ghost" paints nothing; the button renders as the default filled secondary pill
findings.owner: CONSUMER — demo/scenes/notfound/NotFoundPane.vue:17 (plus 25 more `variant="ghost"` sites in demo/, e.g. shared/ui/EmptyState.vue, shell/dock/menus/ProfileSection.vue, color-session/ColorSpaceSelector.vue)
findings.state: unknown address / refused admin / all states
findings.observed: The installed glass-ui 7.0.0 Button (dist/button-Bu9F4uU6.js) declares only emphasis, tone, size and iconOnly, so there is no `variant` prop. `variant="ghost"` falls through as a DOM attribute and the button paints the default emphasis="secondary": a filled glass stadium (bg oklab(0.916 … / 0.52) light, oklab(0.415 … / 0.63) dark) with a drop shadow. The author's quiet 'ghost' intent is not rendered. glass-ui src Button.vue:127-146 now warns on `variant` in DEV, but the pinned 7.0.0 dist has no such warning, so the app gives no signal. No console error was captured.

findings.fix: Migrate at the root: replace every `variant="ghost"` in demo/ with `emphasis="quiet"` (or `text`), with no shim. Then re-judge hover (see the hover finding).

findings.title: Coarse pointer: the size=sm CTA label (21px) outranks the body copy (16px) and nearly matches the title
findings.owner: GLASS — glass-ui tokens: styles/tokens/light-dark.css:19 `--ui-scale: var(--ui-coarse-scale, 1.5)` multiplies `--control-text-sm` (styles/tokens/sizing.css:36 = --type-caption × --ui-scale). Canon: DESIGN.md :929-938 says the 44px target floor is carried by --control-floor / [data-control-target], not by scaling type
findings.observed: The measured button is 236x54px with a 21px label. Body copy is 16px and the pane title is 25.9px. The CTA is the loudest text on the plate after the title; at 1440 the same button is 36px tall with a 16.4px label.
findings.expected: The control-text rung should stay at or below the body rung. Coarse-pointer growth belongs to the hit box (the 44px floor via --control-floor), not to the label type, so the type hierarchy holds: title > body ≥ control label.
findings.fix: Route to the glass-ui session: decouple --control-text-* from --ui-scale under coarse (cap it at --type-body, or scale height/padding only) and let --control-floor carry the 44px target.

The GLASS owner is right, but the ask is framed wrong. glass-ui src/styles/tokens/light-dark.css:6-21 says scaling type on coarse pointers is deliberate canon: 'the WHOLE library … grows ~1.5× on touch from this ONE place … so the touch scale is CONSISTENT'. It is not a bug against DESIGN.md. DESIGN.md:929-938 only says the 44px floor is carried by --control-floor, [data-control-target] and .control-bit; it does not forbid type growth. So the relay should be a canon-change request: decouple --control-text* (sizing.css:35-36) from --ui-scale, or cap it at --type-body. It should not be framed as a violation. Also note two local levers. The chunk-error plate for the same region is a 16px resting Card. At HEAD, ErrorBoundary.vue:20-36 still renders EmptyState directly with no Card, while PaneErrorPlate.vue:20-23 wraps it in a Card. verdicts.title: Loading plate is one generic shape at two different sizes, neither shaped like the pane it stands in for
verdicts.why: In 1440-light-04 the plates are 154px tall at y=425 and sit mid-viewport with dead ground above and below; 390-dark-04b shows the same. In 1440-light-01 the plate is 685px tall, with two bars and one line in the top ~130px and the rest empty. PaneLoadingPlate.vue:15-24 renders the same content for every pane, so the header claim 'shaped like the pane it stands in for' is false.

verdicts.title: Skeleton bars read as opaque slabs with a travelling shimmer band
verdicts.why: The visual defect holds. In 1440-light-04 the bars are cream rgb(246,243,239) on a pink card. In 390-dark-04b they are near-black slabs with a sheen band. The installed 7.0.0 dist rule is `.skeleton{background:var(--muted)}` plus an ::after skeleton-scan animation. The consumer fix is wrong, though. `.skeleton-ink-register` (demo/styles/utils.css:56-59) only sets --skeleton-glass-bg and --skeleton-shimmer-tint, and grep finds no 7.0.0 dist rule that reads --skeleton-glass-bg. So adding the class to the plate would change nothing on the installed glass Skeleton. The app's other 'ink-register' skeletons are also not recolouring glass Skeleton through that seam. The GLASS half is correct: at glass HEAD, Skeleton.vue:47-56 fills with --ink-seam and :88-99 replaces the band with an opacity breathe. The only real cure is adopting glass HEAD. Until then, a consumer override would have to set background on .skeleton directly.

verdicts.title: Chunk-error detail prints the raw loader message: dev URL, absolute filesystem path, cache-buster timestamp
verdicts.why: 1440-light-05 and 390-light-08b show 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: http://localhost:9000/@fs/Users/mkbabb/Programming/…?t=…' breaking mid-token. At 1440 the detail is set in 16.4px Fira, the same size as the button label. The line cite moved: at HEAD the detail is computed at PaneErrorPlate.vue:70 (was :66).

verdicts.why: 1440-light-08 measures two 'Reload the app' buttons, at x=372 and x=902. 390-light-08b shows two stacked plates, each with its own reload. 1440-light-04 and 390-dark-04b show two identical 'Loading the scene…' cards. verdicts.title: Outline Button hover is imperceptible on the plates' recovery actions
verdicts.why: Two parts of the claim are wrong. First, the variant is not outline: the measured button variant is null (default), and both call sites pass only size=sm. Second, hover does paint. The button grows from 124x36 to 126x37 in 1440-light-10 and from 166x36 to 168x37 in 06. That is the 7.0.0 dist `.glass-capsule-hover:hover{scale:1.015; --specular-intensity:0.14}`, with no background tint, which is why the measured background is unchanged. It is subtle, not absent. It does conflict with glass's own DESIGN.md state table, which gives hover as 'Scale up, or bg tint' at --scale-hover 1.08, while the capsule uses a literal 1.015. The owner is GLASS, as a canon-vs-implementation question, and it should be re-checked against HEAD button/styles.css, which is rewritten around data-emphasis. The consumer has no defect here.

findings.title: The expanded debug overlay paints UNDER the picker card: header toggle, gauge values, the FROZEN? badge and the 'copied!' feedback are hidden, and at 390 the header cannot be clicked
findings.owner: CONSUMER (PointerDebugOverlay.vue:136 `z-index: var(--z-debug)`). The root is a GLASS token gap: see the next finding
findings.state: overlay open with gauges/event log; freeze detection; copy
findings.frame: 06-freeze__1440__light.png + __crop.png; 04-expanded-after-drags__390__dark.png; 06-freeze__390__light.png; 08-copy__1440__light__crop.png; capture-log.json (zIndexRaw='auto', zDebugVar='' in all 44 frames; at 390 expanded, headerHit = SPAN.slider-range / DIV.channel-rows, headerHitIsOverlay=false)
findings.observed: `--z-debug` is defined nowhere: not in value.js demo/ and not in glass src or the installed dist. The declaration is invalid at computed-value time, so z-index resolves to `auto`. At 1440 the right ~90 px of the 280 px panel sits under the picker card (x≥200). The 'Debug' title shows, but the '−' collapse glyph, the FROZEN? badge (the one thing freeze detection exists to show) and every gauge VALUE column are hidden; only the keys read. Long values bleed ('div.spe / picker.'). At 390, the viewport this tool exists for (iOS Safari pointer debugging), almost the whole expanded panel, header included, is under the card. elementFromPoint at the header center returns the L slider, so a tap meant to collapse the overlay drives the slider instead.
findings.expected: glass DESIGN.md:353 puts debug overlays on `--z-debug` 99999, above everything, including `--z-max` 9999 (:352). A debug overlay must paint over the content it instruments.
findings.fix: Point the overlay at a z token that exists: `var(--z-max)`, until glass ships `--z-debug` (next finding). Or define `--z-debug` in the demo's style.css :root under a commented rationale. Then re-check the header hit-test at 390 expanded.

findings.title: glass DESIGN.md z-index table documents tokens and values the stylesheet does not ship (`--z-debug` missing, stale rungs)
findings.owner: GLASS: z-index scale (DESIGN.md:335-353 vs src/styles/tokens/scheme-motion.css:197-216)
findings.observed: DESIGN.md lists `--z-debug` 99999, `--z-hovercard` 60, `--z-tooltip` 60, `--z-popover` 70, `--z-modal` 80, `--z-fullscreen` 90 and `--z-toast` 100. The shipped scale has no `--z-debug`, deletes `--z-hovercard` (comment at :206-209), and puts tooltip at 120, popover at 130, modal at 140, fullscreen at 150 and toast at 160, plus `--z-behind` -10 and `--z-toggle` 999, which the table omits. A consumer that followed the canon (value.js PointerDebugOverlay) got an undefined token and a broken overlay.
findings.expected: The DESIGN.md token table matches the shipped scale, and every documented rung resolves.
findings.fix: In glass: either ship `--z-debug: 99999` in the §3 z-index scale (scheme-motion.css) and the bridges.css `--z-index-*` alias set, or delete the row. Re-sync the DESIGN.md table to the shipped values (tooltip 120 / popover 130 / modal 140 / fullscreen 150 / toast 160 / toggle 999 / behind -10; hovercard removed). Route to the glass-ui BK session.

findings.title: Event log cannot be scrolled: `overflow-y:auto` is dead under `pointer-events:none`, and wheel/touch pass through to the page
findings.owner: CONSUMER (PointerDebugOverlay.vue:253-257 `.debug-scroll{overflow-y:auto;pointer-events:none}`, :146 on the root; DebugEventLog.vue:67-73)
findings.frame: 05-log-wheel__1440__light.png, 05-log-wheel__390__light.png; capture-log.json note: log scrollTop 0→0 at both viewports, page scrolled 0→68 at 390; scrollHeight 529 vs clientHeight 243 after reset
findings.observed: With 80 buffered events and gauges filling the 35dvh panel, the log shows only the newest 1-3 events. Wheeling over it scrolls the PAGE, so older events, including the ones before a FREEZE_DETECTED, are unreachable except through Copy JSON. The composable already ignores overlay-origin pointer events (usePointerDebug.ts:151-154 `isDebugOverlay`), so pointer-events:none is not needed to keep the instrument clean.
findings.expected: A scroll container scrolls (DESIGN lens 5/6: the control works when used).
findings.fix: Give the log region `pointer-events:auto` with `touch-action:pan-y` and `overscroll-behavior:contain`, or lift the gauges into a collapsible section so the log gets the height. Delete the dead `overflow-y:auto` if the pass-through is kept on purpose.

findings.title: Overlay is hand-rolled chrome: literal rgba/hex palette, hardcoded font stack, theme-blind, no glass primitives
findings.owner: CONSUMER (PointerDebugOverlay.vue:132-285; DebugEventLog.vue:47-135)
findings.observed: Surface `rgba(0,0,0,0.92)` with a `#e0e0e0` text literal, plus about 20 hex/rgba literals for state colors (#ff4444, #4caf50, #8bc4ff, #b388ff, #ffcc80, rgba(255,60,60,.25)…). Font is `"SF Mono","Fira Code",monospace`, not `var(--font-mono)` (glass bridges.css:90). The header is a raw <button> with '+'/'−' text glyphs, not glass Collapsible/CollapsibleTrigger. Gauges are ad-hoc flex rows, not glass MetricStack/MetricRow/Metric posture="row". The blinking red 'FROZEN?' text stands where glass StatusDot (state=error) would go. The actions are three raw buttons, not glass Button. The surface ignores light theme entirely. The `.debug-section`/`.debug-section-title` rules are duplicated verbatim in both files (PointerDebugOverlay.vue:184-196, DebugEventLog.vue:47-60).
findings.expected: glass DESIGN.md: every surface/control a glass primitive, tokens not literals. demo/DESIGN.md already lists this file as bespoke (:273) for the blink only, not for the palette or surface.
findings.fix: Rebuild on glass: Surface/Card panel (`--radius-panel`), Collapsible for the header, MetricStack+MetricRow for gauges, StatusDot for frozen/active, Button size=sm for actions (variants destructive/secondary/ghost), `--font-mono`, and semantic color tokens (`--destructive`, `--muted-foreground`, …) that follow the theme. Keep the event-type tints as a small token map. Dedupe the section rules into one place. Dev-only surface, so it ranks below user-facing pages.

findings.title: Action buttons are 27 px tall at 10 px type with a 4 px radius: under touch-target size on the mobile tool, and off the radius role table
findings.owner: CONSUMER (PointerDebugOverlay.vue:230-245 `.debug-btn{padding:6px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:10px}`)
findings.frame: 04-expanded-after-drags__390__dark.png; 10-reset__390__light__crop.png; capture-log.json btns: box h=27, radius 4px, font 10px
findings.observed: Reset / Copy JSON / Clear are 83×27 px with 10 px labels and a 4 px (`--radius-sm`) corner. The overlay exists to debug touch on iOS, where 27 px is well under the 44 px target. The 4 px corner is not a role on the canon table. The panel itself uses the raw `--radius-xl` scale step, not the semantic `--radius-panel`.
findings.expected: glass DESIGN.md:385-391 semantic radius roles: action pill = `--radius-control` (stadium, single-line control), panel = `--radius-panel` (12 px). Touch targets ≥ 44 px on a touch-first tool.
findings.fix: Use glass Button size=sm (it carries the control radius and hit area), or at least min-height 36-44 px with `--radius-control`. Swap `var(--radius-xl)` on the overlay (:143) for `var(--radius-panel)`.

findings.title: Gauge formatting: integers render as '1.0', raw performance.now() timestamps shown, long values wrap into the key with no gap
findings.owner: CONSUMER (PointerDebugOverlay.vue:75-79 formatGauge; :198-202 .debug-gauge; usePointerDebug.ts:95,184,190)
findings.observed: `toFixed(1)` is applied to every number, so pointer ids and counts read '1.0' and silenceMs reads '4510.0'. lastForceRelease/lastForceReset show absolute performance.now() ms (90196.9), which means nothing to a reader. `.debug-gauge` is justify-between with no gap, min-width:0 or ellipsis, so the value 'div.spectrum-picker.flex' collides with its key and wraps.
findings.expected: Readouts formatted by kind (integers as integers, durations as relative 'Xs ago'), with key/value separated (glass Metric posture=row handles this).
findings.fix: Format by gauge kind: Number.isInteger → no decimals; timestamps → `${((now-t)/1000).toFixed(1)}s ago`. Add a gap and `min-width:0; text-overflow:ellipsis` to the value, or adopt MetricRow.

findings.title: Synthetic log rows carry noise fields ('p-1', '??')
findings.owner: CONSUMER (usePointerDebug.ts:24 `describeElement` returns '??'; DebugEventLog.vue:13-15)
findings.observed: Events logged with pointerId -1 and a null target (FREEZE_DETECTED, FORCE_RELEASE, FORCE_RESET_DONE, ORPHAN_POINTERS) render 'p-1 ??' before their meaningful `extra` text. That spends the narrow row width and pushes the stuck-pointer detail onto a second line.
findings.expected: Clutter lens: fields that do not apply are omitted.
findings.fix: In DebugEventLog, render the pid only when ≥ 0 and the target only when non-empty. Have describeElement return '' for null.

findings.title: Header disclosure has no focus-visible ring and an inconsistent title alignment
findings.owner: CONSUMER (PointerDebugOverlay.vue:151-165; only .debug-btn has :focus-visible at :242)
findings.frame: 02-header-focus__1440__dark__crop.png (no ring); 01-collapsed vs 03-expanded-empty__1440__light__crop.png ('Debug' left-aligned collapsed, centered expanded)
